# dsh-ptc-router
English | 中文
**Per-task tool-presentation routing for DeepSeek Harness.** Choose PTC or native for each task, and
switch it mid-task without changing the session preset.
## Why
DeepSeek Harness renders an agent's tools in one of two forms:
| Form | The model sees | Best for |

| `native` | every visible tool as a JSON Schema | short, conversational, few-call turns |
| `ptc` |
one `run_code` tool plus a generated SDK | batch, iterative, parallel, data-heavy work |
The form is chosen when the agent is assembled — normally by an agent preset — so a session usually
stays in one form from start to finish. Real sessions mix both: a batch migration, then “why did tha
form from start to finish. Real sessions mix both: a batch migration, then “why did that one fail?”.
This plugin adds the missing per-task choice:

- **Automatic routing** at the start of a task, and again when a new task replaces the old one.
- **

Live switching** from the model or the user, effective on the next step.
- **Agent-scoped override**

that beats the preset's form and unwinds with the agent; subagents keep their own composition.
- **
Graceful fallback** to native when the deployment mounts no PTC runtime.

## Usage
### Automatic
Nothing to do. At agent creation or resume the plugin reads the most recent substantive user message
; each new user message is classified before its first model step. Short continuations (`继续`, `接着`,
`ok`, …) inherit the current form instead of triggering a re-classification.
### `/mode`

In PTC mode the same tool is available inside a program as `tools.switch_tool_mode`.
## How it decides
A weighted, bilingual heuristic over the task text.
- **Towards PTC:** batch / each / iterate, parallel work, scripts and pipelines, repository-wide sco
pe, data processing, audits and migrations, multi-step briefs, long structured prompts, several file

references.
- **Towards native:** short instructions, questions and explanations, single actions, g
reetings, visual/UI requests.
`ptcScore - nativeScore >= threshold` (default `2`) selects PTC. Examples:
| Task | Form |

| `遍历所有文件，统计每个文件的行数并汇总` | ptc |
| `并行下载这些 URL 然后合并结果` | ptc |
| `解释一下这个函数的作用` | native |
| `帮我看下 REA

DME 第一段` | native |
| `继续` | unchanged |
The classifier is deliberately small and testable. The model can always override it with `switch_too
l_mode`, and the user with `/mode`.
## Configuration
Every field is optional; see `cordis.patch.yml` for inline comments.
| Field | Default | Meaning |

| `auto` | `true` | classify tasks automatically |
| `defaultMode` | `native` | form before any task

text, and for `/mode auto` with no history |
| `forceMode` | `auto` | `native` / `ptc` forces one f

orm for every session |
| `threshold` | `2` | score difference needed to pick PTC |
| `guidance` | `

true` | one short prompt paragraph telling the model it may switch |
| `applyToSubagents` | `false`

| also adopt subagents (root agents only by default) |
| `extraPtc` | `[]` | extra PTC keywords (+2

each) |
| `extraNative` | `[]` | extra native keywords (−2 each) |

## How it works
`ctx.tools.presentAs(mode)` is a Cordis effect on the calling scope: one declaration per scope, and
disposing it removes that scope's presentation layer. A switch is therefore “dispose, then declare a
gain” on the agent's own scope — synchronous, and triggered from `agent/inbox/inserted`, which fires
before the driver wakes and assembles the step.
A bare `agent.ctx` cannot access services, so the plugin injects a `tools`-scoped child (`agent.ctx.
inject(['tools'], …)`) and declares there. The declaration keeps the agent's scope tag and unwinds w
ith the agent. Because the agent scope is nearer than the preset scope, it overrides the preset's fo
rm while it lives. Disposal is synchronous for these effects, which is what makes the inbox path rac
e-free; `tools/change` is emitted so other registries re-read the catalog.

## Limits
- A switch changes the tool catalog and the system prompt, so the next request rebuilds its prefix (

one KV-cache miss). That is inherent to changing the form.
- A manual `/mode` pin is not persisted.
After a restart the plugin re-classifies the latest task; use `forceMode` / `defaultMode` for deploy

ment-wide policy.
- Root agents only by default; subagents keep their preset's form.
- `ptc` needs a

mounted `ptcRuntime`. Without one the plugin stays native and says so in `/mode`.
- The live switch
relies on `presentAs`'s dispose-and-redeclare semantics (verified on `0.2.1-rc.2`). Re-run `npm run
spike` after upgrading the harness.
